summary: We study a new problem of preventing object penetration in interactive video world models. To understand how existing models handle this, we introduce NoPeBench, a benchmark that evaluates how world models respond to physical obstacles.
takeaways: To understand how existing models handle this, we introduce NoPeBench, a benchmark that evaluates how world models respond to physical obstacles.
We publicly release our code, the NoPeBench benchmark, and model weights.
Our evaluation reveals that none of the open-source models can reliably prevent such failures.
